title: Website design
body:
Some of those we may or may not want to fix them, just using the website and writing what seems missing. - [x] No hover effect on any link in header - [x] Website width is still very narrow compared to https://community.algolia.com/wordpress/customize-autocomplete.html - [x] Some width break points have no left navigation showing, and you cannot access it - [x] Hover effect on nav triggers line breaks if length is close to limit
![nav](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20346414/254c4446-abfc-11e6-923e-b7f9e596eca2.gif)
- [x] Every first line of code snippets has a indent on it
![2016-11-16-125028_503x51_scrot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20346227/4977d0de-abfb-11e6-8889-a934edfd4120.png)
- [x] Examples page title is "examples introduction" should just be "examples" - [x] Examples page should be designed a bit, a simple page showing screenshots as squares would do it (no need for examples introduction page) - [x] Left nav issue (browser width: 624px)
![leftnav](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20346557/09e3307e-abfd-11e6-8ca9-a3da16361bee.gif)
- [x] Full width API navigation dropdown can't be closed when clicking away - [x] big atom logo does not scale with breakpoints, example:
![](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20347209/5373e564-ac00-11e6-8966-c56238035e31.png)
- [ ] Left nav issue when going from small window to big window (left nav is messed up)
![2016-11-16-130411_1382x787_scrot](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/123822/20346587/320b8f06-abfd-11e6-986e-405ca5cab310.png)
----- - [ ] Properly indent code sample
![](https://puu.sh/sl9KS/8d3f59161d.png)
----- ### done ```diff - No hover effect on any link in header - Website width is still very narrow compared to - Some width break points have no left navigation showing, and you cannot access it - Hover effect on nav triggers line breaks if length is close to limit - Every first line of code snippets has a indent on it - Examples page title is "examples introduction" should just be "examples" - Examples page should be designed a bit, a simple page showing screenshots as squares would do it (no need for examples introduction page) - Left nav issue (browser width: 624px) - Full width API navigation dropdown can't be closed when clicking away - Big atom logo does not scale with breakpoints ``` ### doing ```diff + Left nav issue when going from small window to big window (left nav is messed up) ````
